articles.summaryTr: Amgen’in Imdelltra ilacı ile AstraZeneca’nın Imfinzi tedavisini birleştiren yöntem, ileri evre küçük hücreli akciğer kanseri hastalarında ölüm riskini yüzde 58 azalttı. Çalışmada ortanca genel sağkalım 12,7 aydan 21,1 aya yükseldi.
articles.articleText: Kansere karşı dikkat çeken sonuç: Yeni yöntem ölüm riskini yüzde 60'a yakın azalttı - Amgen’in Imdelltra ilacı ile AstraZeneca’nın Imfinzi tedavisini birleştiren yöntem, ileri evre küçük hücreli akciğer kanseri hastalarında ölüm riskini yüzde 58 azalttı. Çalışmada ortanca genel sağkalım 12,7 aydan 21,1 aya yükseldi. ABD’li biyoteknoloji şirketi Amgen’in geliştirdiği Imdelltra ilacının, AstraZeneca’nın Imfinzi immünoterapisine eklenmesi, agresif bir akciğer kanseri türünde dikkat çekici sonuçlar ortaya koydu. İleri evre küçük hücreli akciğer kanseri hastalarında yürütülen ileri aşama klinik çalışmanın tam sonuçlarına göre, iki ilacın birlikte kullanılması ölüm riskini yüzde 58 azalttı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Cumartesi günü açıklanan sonuçlarda, iki ilacı birlikte alan hastaların ortanca genel sağkalım süresi 21,1 ay olarak ölçüldü. Yalnızca Imfinzi kullanan grupta bu süre 12,7 ayda kaldı. Bir yıllık sağkalım oranı yüzde 80’e yaklaştı Araştırmada, başlangıç tedavisinde Imfinzi ve kemoterapi alan, ancak kanseri ilerlemeyen hastalar incelendi. Bu hastalarda Imdelltra’nın idame tedavisi olarak eklenmesinin etkisi değerlendirildi. Amgen’in açıklamasına göre iki ilacı birlikte kullanan hastaların yaklaşık yüzde 80’i bir yılın sonunda hayattaydı. Yalnızca Imfinzi alan grupta ise bu oran yüzde 53 olarak kaydedildi. Ortanca genel sağkalım, bir hasta grubundaki kişilerin yarısının daha uzun, diğer yarısının ise daha kısa süre yaşadığı noktayı ifade ediyor. Buna göre kombinasyon tedavisi alan grupta hastaların yarısı en az yaklaşık 21 ay yaşadı. Amgen’in Baş Tıp Sorumlusu Dr. Paul Burton, sonuçların hastalar için standart tedaviyi değiştirebilecek ölçüde önemli olduğunu söyledi. Burton, kombinasyonun en agresif kanser türlerinden biriyle mücadelede yeni bir yaklaşım sunabileceğini belirtti. Agresif kanser türünde tedavi ihtiyacı sürüyor Küçük hücreli akciğer kanseri, hızlı büyümesi ve başlangıçta tedaviye yanıt verse bile çoğu zaman aylar içinde yeniden ilerlemesiyle biliniyor. Çalışmanın baş araştırmacısı ve Dana-Farber Kanser Enstitüsü’nden Dr. Jacob Sands, immünoterapinin bazı hastalarda hastalığın yıllarca kontrol altında tutulmasını sağladığını, ancak bu faydanın hastaların çoğunda aynı ölçüde görülmediğini ifade etti. Sands, çalışmada elde edilen faydaların kanseri beyin veya karaciğere yayılmış hastalar dahil farklı hasta gruplarında gözlendiğini söyledi. Bu organlara yayılan hastalık, daha kötü tedavi sonuçlarıyla ilişkilendiriliyor. ABD’de her yıl yaklaşık 31 bin yeni küçük hücreli akciğer kanseri vakası görülüyor. Hastaların tahminen yüzde 60 ila 70’i, kanserin başladığı akciğerin dışına yayıldığı ileri evrede teşhis ediliyor. Imdelltra daha erken aşamada kullanılabilir Imdelltra şu anda platin bazlı kemoterapi sırasında veya sonrasında hastalığı ilerleyen küçük hücreli akciğer kanseri hastaları için onaylı. Yeni çalışma ise ilacın tedavinin daha erken bir aşamasında, Imfinzi ile birlikte kullanılmasının etkilerini değerlendirdi. Amgen, sonuçların Imdelltra’nın ilk tedavi sonrasındaki idame dönemine eklenmesinin hastalığın seyrini anlamlı biçimde değiştirebileceğine işaret ettiğini belirtti. Bununla birlikte çalışma, bu kombinasyonun diğer ilk basamak tedavi seçeneklerinden daha etkili olup olmadığını test etmedi. Dolayısıyla sonuçlar, farklı tedavi yaklaşımları arasında doğrudan bir üstünlük karşılaştırması sunmuyor. İki ilaç kanser hücrelerine farklı yollarla saldırıyor Imdelltra, kanser hücrelerinde bulunan DLL3 proteini ile bağışıklık hücrelerinden T hücrelerinde bulunan CD3 proteinine bağlanıyor. Bu mekanizma, T hücrelerini tümör hücrelerine yaklaştırarak bağışıklık sisteminin kanser hücrelerine saldırmasına yardımcı oluyor. AstraZeneca’nın geliştirdiği Imfinzi ise kanser hücrelerinin bağışıklık sisteminden kaçmak için kullandığı PD-L1 adlı proteini engelliyor. Böylece iki ilaç, bağışıklık sisteminin kanserle mücadele etmesine farklı ancak birbirini tamamlayan mekanizmalarla destek veriyor. Çalışma sonuçları, Avrupa Tıbbi Onkoloji Derneği’nin (ESMO) kongresinde sunuldu. Bir hastanın tedavi süreci de dikkat çekti Denver’da yaşayan 44 yaşındaki iki çocuk annesi Kate Brenan’a, Ocak 2024’ün başında ileri evre küçük hücreli akciğer kanseri teşhisi konuldu. Brenan, altı kür kemoterapi aldı; ardından göğüs bölgesine radyasyon tedavisi uygulandı. Kanserin yayılmasının ardından tüm beyin radyasyonu da gördü. Eylül 2024’te Imdelltra tedavisine başlayan Brenan, o tarihten bu yana hastalık bulgusuna rastlanmadığını söyledi. Brenan, ilacın daha erken tedavi seçeneği haline gelme ihtimalinin hastalar açısından olumlu bir gelişme olduğunu ifade etti. Imdelltra’nın satışları da artıyor Klinik sonuçlar, Amgen’in ilacı için ticari açıdan da yeni bir fırsat oluşturabilir. Imdelltra, 2026’nın ikinci çeyreğinde 288 milyon dolar satış geliri elde etti. Bu rakam, geçen yılın aynı dönemine göre yüzde 115 artışa işaret ediyor. İlaç, 2025 yılında küresel ölçekte 627 milyon dolarlık satış gerçekleştirdi. Satışların bu seviyeden yükselmesi, yıllık 1 milyar dolar satış eşiğinin aşılması ihtimalini gündeme getiriyor.

articles.title: Man arrested after fire at Hitler's mountaintop Eagle's Nest retreat
articles.summary: Some 200 emergency personnel were deployed to fight the blaze at the Nazi dictator's Alpine residence in Germany.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Man arrested after fire at Hitler's mountaintop Eagle's Nest retreat
articles.summaryTr: Some 200 emergency personnel were deployed to fight the blaze at the Nazi dictator's Alpine residence in Germany.
articles.articleText: Man arrested after fire at Hitler's mountaintop Eagle's Nest retreat - Published Police in the southern German state of Bavaria have detained a 33-year-old German man during a fire at Adolf Hitler's Alpine mountain retreat, the Kehlsteinhaus, also known as the Eagle's Nest. Dispatchers in Traunstein received a fire alarm from the building at 21:15 local time (19:15 GMT) on Friday and firefighters found it engulfed in flames. Some 200 emergency personnel were deployed to the scene where the blaze was still burning early on Saturday, as police said difficult terrain hindered efforts to bring the fire under control. Police said they apprehended the man riding a motorcycle near the scene, German media reported. A criminal investigation has been launched. There is currently nothing to suggest the involvement of further suspects, police official Gerhart Holzinger told a press conference on Saturday afternoon. Public prosecutor Rainer Vietze said a psychiatric report had concluded the 33-year-old man showed signs of possible mental illness and diminished responsibility might therefore be assumed. Vietze said a possible political motive was also being considered, but stressed the investigation was in its early stages. The residence, above the town of Berchtesgaden, was one of several buildings in the area used by the Nazi dictator and his entourage during World War Two. Hitler and top Nazi officials used his nearby Berghof residence to plan the invasion of the USSR in 1941 and the whole complex was considered one of his headquarters. He also used the area as a backdrop for propaganda films portraying him as a lover of animals and nature. Local media reported that site had been "largely destroyed" and the public was urged to avoid the area. Bavaria's Interior Minister Joachim Herrmann told reporters that the site would "under no circumstances remain a ruin", broadcaster BR24 reported. "It is important that we continue our work of remembrance," he added. Completed by the Nazis in 1938, the Eagle's Nest, which sits at an elevation of around 1,800m (5,900ft), escaped destruction after their defeat in 1945. Since then, it has become a popular tourist destination and houses a mountain inn. It serves as "a cautionary reminder of the abysses of the inhumane Nazi dictatorship", according to its official website, external. During WW2, Hitler and his followers were responsible for the deaths of tens of millions of people, including the mass murder of European Jews. Homosexuals, gypsies, the disabled and ethnic minorities were sent to concentration camps and put to death. There has been a wider debate in Germany and Vienna over whether to preserve, repurpose or demolish buildings connected to Hitler. While some say these buildings should be preserved for historical reasons, others have raised concerns that they could be used as monuments or places of pilgrimage for neo-Nazis and far-right extremists. In June, Berlin authorities announced they would tear down one of Hitler's bunkers - described at the time as "the power centre of Nazi Germany" - to build flats and offices on the site. Those critical of the plans said the bunker had "significant historical value" and that it should have been turned into a museum and memorial site with an exhibit about the end of the war. And in July, after years of controversy, Austrian authorities refurbished the house in the town of Braunau am Inn in which Hitler was born and turned it into a police station. articles.articleText: Muhasebe işinden dikiş atölyesine: 375 dolarla gelen girişimcilik hikayesi - ABD’li Eric Lugo, ikinci el 8 dikiş makinesi için harcadığı 375 dolarla atölyesini kurdu. İşini kaybettikten sonra tüm zamanını girişimine ayıran Lugo, bugün ayda yaklaşık 24 atölye düzenliyor ve işletmeden maaş alıyor. ABD’nin Teksas eyaletine bağlı Austin kentinde yaşayan 29 yaşındaki Eric Lugo, küçük bir yan iş olarak başladığı dikiş atölyesini kısa sürede tam zamanlı işine dönüştürdü. Mayıs 2025’te kurduğu Stitch Lab ATX, bugün düzenli olarak dolan sınıfları, özel etkinlikleri ve genişleyen eğitim programıyla faaliyet gösteriyor. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Lugo’nun girişimi, ikinci el sekiz dikiş makinesi için yaptığı 375 dolarlık yatırımla başladı. Facebook Marketplace üzerinden aldığı makineleri, bir arkadaşının mesai saatleri dışında kullanılmayan depo alanına yerleştirdi. İlk ders programını ise arkadaşları ve ailesiyle deneyerek geliştirdi. Dikiş öğrenme fikri iş modeline dönüştü Lugo, dikiş dikmeyi henüz 5 yaşındayken büyükannesinden öğrendi. Ergenlik döneminde bu alana daha fazla ilgi duymaya başladı ve ilerleyen yıllarda Casa Amiré adlı kendi moda markasını kurdu. Arkadaşlarının pantolon paçalarını kısaltma ve elbiselerini düzeltme gibi talepleri de zamanla arttı. Nisan 2024’te arkadaşlarına kıyafetlerini kendilerinin tamir etmeyi öğretme fikri üzerinde düşünmeye başladı. Lugo, dikişin birçok insanın bilmediği ancak önemli bir beceri olduğunu fark ettiğini söyledi. Bir süre bu fikri hayata geçirmeyen Lugo, Ağustos 2024 civarında yerel bir halkla ilişkiler şirketinde muhasebe kayıtlarıyla ilgili bir işe girdi. Ancak 2025’in başında atölye kurma düşüncesi yeniden gündemine geldi. Derslerin içeriğini ve girişimini nasıl tanıtacağını planlamaya başladı. TikTok ve iş birlikleri talebi artırdı Girişimin büyümesi zaman aldı. Yaklaşık iki buçuk saat süren derslerin ücretleri 65 ila 85 dolar arasında değişiyor. Banka, daha pahalı hale gelen eğlence ve hobi faaliyetlerine yönelik bu eğilimi “funflation” olarak tanımlıyor. Lugo ise kendisine verilen desteğin bir bölümünü topluma geri kazandırmak amacıyla Ağustos ayında Sew It Forward adlı aylık bir kampanya başlattı. Kampanya kapsamında katılımcılar, neden dikiş öğrenmek istediklerini sosyal medyada paylaşarak ücretsiz dikiş makinesi, malzeme ve atölye dersi kazanma fırsatı elde ediyor. articles.titleTr: Why McDonalds, Microsoft and Google saying no to tokenized stocks isn't a dealbreaker

articles.articleText: Why McDonalds, Microsoft and Google saying no to tokenized stocks isn't a dealbreaker Some of the world's biggest companies objected to being listed on the first tokenized securities trading venue under the SEC's innovation exemption. But the early pushback may say more about issuer caution than about rejection of tokenization itself. This is an excerpt from CoinDesk's new ‘Tokenization Weekly’ newsletter that will be launching soon. Sign-up details will be here when it goes live. The SEC's new framework for tokenized stock trading looked, at first glance, roughly a month ago, like a fast track to putting U.S. equities on crypto rails. The first real-world test hasn't looked particularly encouraging so far. A growing group of public companies has objected to having their shares traded on the tokenized-securities venue being built by OKX and Intercontinental Exchange (ICE), the owner of the New York Stock Exchange. This week’s of objections included some of the biggest names yet: Microsoft (MSFT), Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL), Goldman Sachs (GS) McDonalds (MCD) and three others on Monday, then Wells Fargo (WFC) and Cisco (CSCO) and four more firms on Friday rejected having tokenized versions of their shares traded on OKXICE, bringing the disclosed total now to 22 objecting issuers. Seeing some of the world's largest companies say no may not exactly be the start that tokenization advocates had hoped for. But it also isn't necessarily a major blow to the SEC's experiment. Why it matters Before trading in a company's shares, a venue must notify the issuer and give the issuer 30 days to object. If the company stays silent, trading can begin. That gives public companies a say in whether unaffiliated third parties tokenize and trade their shares, but it also tilts the decision toward caution. Global law firm Latham & Watkins has warned issuers that silence effectively becomes an irrevocable decision: the SEC order provides no mechanism to object after the 30-day window or withdraw a prior non-objection once trading begins. So when a legal or investor-relations team receives notice about a new market structure it may know little about, saying no while it figures things out can be the rational choice. “Most of these companies had no idea a third party had tokenized their stock until the OKXICE notice went up,” Dave Hendricks, CEO and founder of tokenization firm Vertalo, told CoinDesk. “Once they do, the questions come fast: who holds the shares behind the token, how do dividends and votes reach those holders, what does the transfer agent see?” he added. If those questions can't be answered within 30 days, he said, objecting makes sense. Olivia Vande Woude, head of tokenization at Ava Labs, also cautioned against reading the growing list as a verdict on OKXICE. “It's the first venue to send notices under the SEC's Innovation Exemption, so it's the first to get the answers,” she said. And because objecting costs nothing while silence counts as consent, she expects the list to keep growing. “Given how easy the opt-out is, the list of objectors is likely to keep growing, and the next venue that sends notices should expect similar resistance,” Vande Woude said. That may be less a sign that the experiment is failing than an indication of what the experiment is uncovering. “This exemption is a data-gathering exercise,” Vande Woude said. “What it's showing is that public companies want a say in how their shares come onchain.” What comes next Nasdaq offers a useful example of what the objections do – and don't – mean. The exchange operator has been a vocal supporter of tokenization and is pursuing its own model for tokenized securities. But Nasdaq Inc., whose shares trade under NDAQ, said it intends to object to having tokenized versions of its own stock traded on TSVs under the current exemption. That reflects a disagreement over market structure, not tokenization itself. Nasdaq warned that TSVs operating outside the National Market System (NMS) could fragment liquidity, weaken price discovery and lack safeguards such as real-time best-price display and consolidated-tape reporting. Its own model keeps tokenized securities inside the existing exchange framework. There is also a simpler question for issuers: what's in it for them? Reid Noch, vice president of U.S. equity market structure at TD Securities, told CoinDesk the bigger issue is that the upside for issuers remains difficult to quantify. Tokenization could bring additional demand for U.S. shares, particularly from overseas investors, but the SEC framework may not generate enough new demand to offset the risks of thin, 24/7 trading outside the familiar market structure. That doesn't mean everyone is saying no. Securitize (SECZ), which specializes in tokenized securities, told CoinDesk it does not plan to object to inclusion on the OKX-ICE venue. A representative of digital asset custodian BitGo (BTGO) also said in an email that the company won't object to the listing. Both have an obvious interest in helping the tokenized-asset market grow, but Securitize's response also pointed to what may be needed for more traditional companies to get comfortable. “There's an important education process underway,” CEO Carlos Domingo said. The firm said it has been reaching out to issuers that are or may become involved with its own tokenized stocks, including through webinars explaining the different trading models, shareholder rights and potential trade-offs. That probably offers the clearest glimpse of what comes next: Education and time. The SEC may have removed one regulatory barrier to tokenized stock trading. Getting public companies comfortable enough to use it could take considerably longer. Diversified RWA stablecoins sustain 5-7% yield from real credit as crypto funding compresses to ~4%. Ton başına 1.000 doların üzerine çıkan fiyatlar, gübre üretiminden bakır ve nikel madenciliğine kadar birçok sektörde üretim baskısını artırdı. Küresel kükürt tedarikinde yaşanan daralma, tarımdan madenciliğe ve elektronik sanayisine kadar birçok sektörü etkiliyor. The Economist’in değerlendirmesine göre İran savaşı, Basra Körfezi’ndeki rafinerileri ve kükürt sevkiyatlarını etkileyerek uluslararası piyasalardaki arz açığını büyüttü. Hürmüz Boğazı’ndaki kapanma, küresel kükürt üretiminin yaklaşık dörtte birinin ve deniz yoluyla yapılan ihracatın yaklaşık yarısının Körfez bölgesinde sıkışmasına neden oldu. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Kükürtün büyük bölümü petrol ve doğal gaz işleme süreçlerinde yan ürün olarak elde ediliyor. Bu nedenle enerji sektöründeki üretim ve sevkiyat aksaklıkları, kükürt piyasasına da doğrudan yansıyor. Kükürt fiyatları ton başına 1.000 doları aştı Küresel arzın daralmasıyla kükürt fiyatları sert yükseldi. Haziran ayında birçok bölgeye yapılan sevkiyatlarda fiyatların ton başına 1.000 doların üzerine çıkarak rekor seviyelere ulaştığı bildirildi. Orta Doğu’dan yapılan kükürt ihracatının 2026 yılında 11 milyon tonun altında kalması bekleniyor. Bu miktar, 2025’te kaydedilen 20,5 milyon tonluk ihracatın oldukça gerisinde bulunuyor. ABD ve Kanada’nın ihracatını artırmasına rağmen Körfez dışındaki arzın savaş öncesi seviyelerin yaklaşık yüzde 40 altında kaldığı belirtiliyor. Bölge dışındaki sevkiyatlar, ortaya çıkan açığı kapatmakta yetersiz kalıyor. Rusya ve Türkiye dahil ülkeler ihracatı askıya aldı Kükürt piyasasındaki daralmayı artıran unsurlar arasında ihracat kısıtlamaları da yer alıyor. Rusya’nın kükürt ihracatı, 2025’teki 4,8 milyon tondan 2026’da şu ana kadar 1,8 milyon tona geriledi. Rusya’nın yanı sıra Hindistan, Kazakistan ve Türkiye’nin de kükürt ihracatını askıya aldığı bildirildi. Bu adımlar, küresel alıcıların alternatif tedarik kaynaklarına ulaşmasını zorlaştırıyor. Çin’in mayıs ayında sülfürik asit ihracatını yasaklaması da arz baskısını artıran gelişmeler arasında yer aldı. Ülkenin asit ihracatının neredeyse sıfıra inmesi, kükürt ve türevlerini kullanan sektörlerdeki tedarik sorunlarını ağırlaştırdı. Gübre üreticileri maliyet baskısıyla karşı karşıya Kükürt kıtlığından en fazla etkilenen alanların başında fosfatlı gübre üretimi geliyor. Gübre üretiminde kullanılan sülfürik asidin temel girdilerinden biri olan kükürt, üretim maliyetleri açısından kritik önem taşıyor. Verilen bilgilere göre 10 ton gübre üretmek için yaklaşık 4 ton kükürt gerekiyor. Ham madde fiyatlarındaki yükseliş, üreticilerin maliyetlerini artırırken bazı tesislerde faaliyetlerin sürdürülmesini zorlaştırıyor. ABD, Brezilya, Mısır ve Fas’taki bazı tesislerin üretimi durdurduğu veya yavaşlattığı bildirildi. Üretimdeki aksaklıkların devam etmesi, tarımsal üretim maliyetleri ve çiftçilerin gübreye erişimi üzerinde ek baskı oluşturabilir. Bakır ve nikel madenciliği de etkileniyor Kükürt arzındaki daralma, gübre sektörünün yanı sıra madencilik faaliyetlerini de etkiliyor. Bakır ve nikel üretiminde cevherden metal elde etmek için yüksek miktarda sülfürik asit kullanılıyor. Kükürt tedarikindeki sorunlar, bu asidin üretimini ve madencilik süreçlerini aksatabiliyor. Özellikle Endonezya’da kükürt alımlarının yüzde 75 azaldığı, nikel madencilerinin ise bakım çalışmalarını öne çektiği bildirildi. Ham maddeye erişimdeki sorunlar, işletmelerin üretim planlarını yeniden değerlendirmesine neden oluyor. Etkiler elektronik sanayisine de uzanabilir Kükürt ve sülfürik asit, bazı elektronik bileşenlerin üretiminde kullanılan ham maddelerin işlenmesinde de önemli rol oynuyor. Bu nedenle tedarik sıkıntısının etkileri tarım ve madencilikle sınırlı kalmayabilir; farklı sanayi kollarına da yayılabilir. Yeni üretim kapasitesi açığı kapatmaya yetmeyebilir Çin ve Hindistan’da yeni kükürt üretim kapasitesinin devreye alınması bekleniyor. Ancak bu yatırımların mevcut arz açığını zamanında kapatmasının zor olduğu değerlendiriliyor. Kısa vadede piyasadaki rahatlamanın, savaş öncesinde planlanan yeni projelerin bulunduğu Körfez bölgesinden sevkiyatların yeniden başlamasına bağlı olduğu belirtiliyor.

articles.articleText: Borsada bir haftada 222 geri alım hamlesi: 79 şirket kendi hisselerini aldı Borsa İstanbul'da 19-23 Ekim haftasında 79 farklı şirket kendi paylarında geri alım gerçekleştirdi. Beş işlem gününde toplam 222 şirket bazlı geri alım kaydı oluşurken, bazı şirketlerin milyonlarca lotluk alımları dikkat çekti. Peki, hangi şirket ne kadar hisse geri aldı? Borsa İstanbul'da 19-23 Ekim haftasında 79 farklı şirket pay geri alımı gerçekleştirdi. Beş işlem gününde toplam 222 şirket bazlı geri alım kaydı oluşurken, bazı şirketler haftanın tamamında, bazıları ise belirli günlerde kendi hisselerini satın aldı. İşte şirketlerin gün gün gerçekleştirdiği geri alımların tamamı. Borsa İstanbul'da işlem gören şirketlerin pay geri alımları 19-23 Ekim haftasında devam etti. Derlenen verilere göre pazartesi 41, salı 42, çarşamba 47, perşembe 48 ve cuma 44 şirket kendi paylarında alım gerçekleştirdi. Hafta boyunca geri alım yapan farklı şirket sayısı 79 olurken, günlük şirket sayılarının toplamı 222 olarak hesaplandı. Geri alım miktarları bakımından Akfen GYO, Tukaş Gıda, Tatlıpınar Enerji ve Gedik Yatırım öne çıktı. İşte haftanın geri alım yapan 79 şirketi... 1. Mavi Giyim (MAVI): Şirket, 19 Ekim Pazartesi 350.000 lot, 21 Ekim Çarşamba 350.000 lot ve 23 Ekim Cuma 349.715 lot olmak üzere hafta boyunca toplam 1.049.715 lot pay geri aldı. 2. Orzaks İlaç (ORZAX): Şirket, 19 Ekim Pazartesi günü 688.000 lot pay geri alımı gerçekleştirdi. 3. Ağaoğlu Avrasya GYO (AAGYO): Şirket, 19 Ekim Pazartesi 250.000 lot, 20 Ekim Salı 2.711.000 lot olmak üzere toplam 2.961.000 lot pay geri aldı. 4. Kapeks Kimya (KPEKS): Şirket, 19 Ekim Pazartesi 100.000 lot, 20 Ekim Salı 1.257 lot, 21 Ekim Çarşamba 75.000 lot, 22 Ekim Perşembe 50.000 lot ve 23 Ekim Cuma 50.000 lot olmak üzere toplam 276.257 lot geri alım yaptı. 5. articles.articleTextTr: Borsada bir haftada 222 geri alım hamlesi: 79 şirket kendi hisselerini aldı Borsa İstanbul'da 19-23 Ekim haftasında 79 farklı şirket kendi paylarında geri alım gerçekleştirdi. Beş işlem gününde toplam 222 şirket bazlı geri alım kaydı oluşurken, bazı şirketlerin milyonlarca lotluk alımları dikkat çekti. Peki, hangi şirket ne kadar hisse geri aldı? Borsa İstanbul'da 19-23 Ekim haftasında 79 farklı şirket pay geri alımı gerçekleştirdi. Beş işlem gününde toplam 222 şirket bazlı geri alım kaydı oluşurken, bazı şirketler haftanın tamamında, bazıları ise belirli günlerde kendi hisselerini satın aldı. İşte şirketlerin gün gün gerçekleştirdiği geri alımların tamamı. Borsa İstanbul'da işlem gören şirketlerin pay geri alımları 19-23 Ekim haftasında devam etti. Derlenen verilere göre pazartesi 41, salı 42, çarşamba 47, perşembe 48 ve cuma 44 şirket kendi paylarında alım gerçekleştirdi. Hafta boyunca geri alım yapan farklı şirket sayısı 79 olurken, günlük şirket sayılarının toplamı 222 olarak hesaplandı. articles.titleTr: Ziraat Portföy’den fon iddialarına yanıt: Tera Portföy ile iş ilişkimiz olmadı
articles.summaryTr: Ziraat Portföy, ZJB ve ZJI kodlu fonlara ilişkin iddialar üzerine yaptığı açıklamada, fon paylarının yaklaşık yüzde 95’inin Ziraat Bankası’na ait olduğunu belirtti. Şirket, belirli kişi ve gruplara menfaat sağlandığı iddialarını reddetti.
articles.articleText: Ziraat Portföy’den fon iddialarına yanıt: Tera Portföy ile iş ilişkimiz olmadı - Ziraat Portföy, ZJB ve ZJI kodlu fonlara ilişkin iddialar üzerine yaptığı açıklamada, fon paylarının yaklaşık yüzde 95’inin Ziraat Bankası’na ait olduğunu belirtti. Şirket, belirli kişi ve gruplara menfaat sağlandığı iddialarını reddetti. Ziraat Portföy, yönettiği Ziraat Portföy Birinci Serbest (TL) Fon (ZJB) ve Ziraat Portföy İkinci Serbest (TL) Fon (ZJI) hakkındaki iddialara ilişkin yeni bir açıklama yaptı. Şirket, 16 Ekim 2026 tarihli açıklamasının ardından benzer iddiaların yeniden gündeme getirilmesi üzerine kamuoyunu bir kez daha bilgilendirme ihtiyacı duyduğunu bildirdi. Fonlar hangi amaçla kuruldu? CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Açıklamaya göre ZJB ve ZJI kodlu fonlar, Ziraat Bankası’nın 2021 yılında Ziraat GYO paylarına yönelik geri alım taahhüdü kapsamında edindiği hisselerin değerlendirilmesi amacıyla kuruldu. Şirket, fonların Türkiye Elektronik Fon Alım Satım Platformu’nda (TEFAS) işlem görmeye başlamasından önce katılma paylarının tamamının Ziraat Bankası ve Ziraat Portföy’e ait olduğunu belirtti. Açıklamada, fonların TEFAS’ta işlem görmeye başlamasının ardından da katılma paylarının yaklaşık yüzde 95’inin Ziraat Bankası’na ait olmaya devam ettiği ifade edildi. Fon getirileri için BIST 100 ve GYO endeksleri karşılaştırıldı Ziraat Portföy, fonların TEFAS’ta işlem görmeye başlamasından önceki getirilerinin aynı dönemlerde BIST 100 ve BIST Gayrimenkul Yatırım Ortaklıkları endekslerinin getirilerinin altında kaldığını bildirdi. Açıklamaya göre fonların TEFAS’ta işlem görmeye başlamasının ardından elde ettiği getiriler ise ilgili endekslerle uyumlu seyretti ve olağandışı bir ayrışma göstermedi. Emeklilik fonlarının Ziraat GYO paylarındaki oranı açıklandı Şirket, kamuoyuyla paylaşılan portföy raporlarına da atıfta bulunarak, yönettiği Türkiye Hayat ve Emeklilik fonlarının portföylerinde Ziraat GYO paylarının yalnızca yüzde 0,0015’lik bir bölüm oluşturduğunu belirtti. Tera Portföy iddiasına yanıt Ziraat Portföy, açıklamasında Tera Portföy ile herhangi bir iş ilişkisinin hiçbir dönemde bulunmadığını da kaydetti. Şirket, ZJB ve ZJI kodlu fonların belirli kişi ve gruplara menfaat sağlamak amacıyla kullanıldığı yönündeki iddiaların gerçeği yansıtmadığını savundu. Açıklamanın sonunda tüm fonların sermaye piyasası mevzuatına uygun biçimde ve yatırımcıların menfaatleri gözetilerek yönetildiği ifade edildi.

articles.title: Wells Fargo, Cisco, Marvell among latest firms objecting to OKXICE's tokenized stock plan
articles.summary: Six more companies have objected to listing tokenized versions of their stock on the venue, Reuters reported, bringing the total to 22.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Wells Fargo, Cisco, Marvell among latest firms objecting to OKXICE's tokenized stock plan
articles.summaryTr: Six more companies have objected to listing tokenized versions of their stock on the venue, Reuters reported, bringing the total to 22.
articles.articleText: Wells Fargo, Cisco, Marvell among latest firms objecting to OKXICE's tokenized stock plan Six more companies have objected to listing tokenized versions of their stock on the venue, Reuters reported, bringing the total to 22. - Cisco, Wells Fargo, Marvell, Arm, Intuit and Moderna opted out of OKXICE’s plans to offer blockchain-based trading of their tokenized shares, bringing the total number of objections to 22. - The growing list highlights a hurdle for the joint venture of the crypto exchange and NYSE parent under the SEC’s new framework, which gives issuers 30 days to block their shares from trading on a tokenized securities venue. - OKXICE co-chairman Andrew Cuomo said objections were expected, with many companies preferring to wait and see how the new market works before participating. Cisco (CSCO), Wells Fargo (WFC) and four other companies have opted out of plans by crypto exchange OKX and New York Stock Exchange parent Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) to offer blockchain-based trading of their shares, bringing the total objections to 22 as issuers weigh participation in the SEC’s new framework for tokenized stocks. The companies, along with Arm Holdings (ARM), Moderna (MRNA), Intuit (INTU) and Marvell Technology (MRVL), were named in an updated public notice filed Friday by OKXICE, the two firms’ joint venture. The additions extend a list that already included some of the world’s largest publicly traded companies, such as Microsoft ·, Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL), Goldman Sachs (GS) and McDonald’s and said no to the venue’s plan in recent weeks. The growing number of objections signals a hurdle for a new market structure that would let U.S. investors trade stocks around the clock on blockchains. The SEC’s five-year “Innovation Exemption” allows qualifying tokenized securities venues, or TSVs, to test trading through automated market makers — software that executes trades using pools of assets — while giving issuers a say in whether their shares participate. OKXICE, backed by one of the world's biggest exchange operators, issued its initial public notice on Oct. 4, outlining plans to use Uniswap (UNI) liquidity pools on OKX’s XLayer blockchain, with transactions settled in stablecoins. Venues must notify issuers and give them 30 days to object before offering tokenized versions of their shares. The venture’s original proposed trading roster covered 62 companies. Wells Fargo and ARM were not among them, while Cisco, Moderna, Intuit and Marvell were included. That means the 22 objections cannot all be counted as departures from the original selection. Cerebras Systems, whose objection was disclosed earlier, was also outside that roster. An objection blocks trading on the notifying venue but does not establish opposition to every form of stock tokenization. Companies take a wait-and-see approach Andrew Cuomo, OKXICE’s co-chairman and former New York governor, said earlier this week that such responses were expected. “We always anticipated that, because this is such a dramatic and revolutionary change, many companies would want to wait and see how it goes rather than be the first to participate,” Cuomo said during a Monday press call. Limits on participating companies and trading volumes make the framework “a sandbox — a model demonstration,” he said. Diversified RWA stablecoins sustain 5-7% yield from real credit as crypto funding compresses to ~4%. GENIUS pushes yield off-chain; TAM grows to $4B in 3 years. articles.summary: Fransa’da protestolar büyürken bütçe açığı ve ekonomik büyümeye ilişkin endişeler artıyor. Tahvil faizleri 2002’den bu yana en yüksek seviyeye çıkarken yatırımcılar, siyasi krizin piyasalar ve şirketler üzerindeki etkisini değerlendiriyor.

articles.titleTr: Fransa’da protestolar piyasaları sarstı: Yatırımcıların gözü üç kritik soruda
articles.summaryTr: Fransa’da protestolar büyürken bütçe açığı ve ekonomik büyümeye ilişkin endişeler artıyor. Tahvil faizleri 2002’den bu yana en yüksek seviyeye çıkarken yatırımcılar, siyasi krizin piyasalar ve şirketler üzerindeki etkisini değerlendiriyor.
articles.articleText: Fransa’da protestolar piyasaları sarstı: Yatırımcıların gözü üç kritik soruda Fransa’da protestolar büyürken bütçe açığı ve ekonomik büyümeye ilişkin endişeler artıyor. Tahvil faizleri 2002’den bu yana en yüksek seviyeye çıkarken yatırımcılar, siyasi krizin piyasalar ve şirketler üzerindeki etkisini değerlendiriyor. Fransa’da protestolar piyasaları sarstı! Fransa’da hükümet karşıtı protestolar, ülkenin kamu maliyesine ve ekonomik büyüme görünümüne ilişkin endişeleri artırıyor. Yeni gösteriler öncesinde yatırımcılar, siyasi belirsizliğin bütçe hedeflerini, ekonomik büyümeyi ve şirketlerin faaliyetlerini nasıl etkileyeceğini değerlendiriyor. Tahvil faizleri 2002’den bu yana en yüksek seviyeye çıkarken ülkenin kredi notu görünümü de negatifte tutuluyor. MOODY’S’TEN NEGATİF GÖRÜNÜM Fransa’nın kredi notu korundu, endişeler sürüyor Kredi derecelendirme kuruluşu Moody’s, cuma günü Fransa’nın kredi notunu Aa3 seviyesinde korudu ancak ülkenin not görünümünü negatifte tuttu. Kuruluş, Fransa’nın siyasi yapısındaki parçalanmanın yasama kurumlarının işleyişini olumsuz etkileme riskinin arttığını belirtti. Moody’s ayrıca, ülkenin bütçe açığını azaltma konusunda ilerleme kaydetmesi halinde görünümün yeniden durağana çevrilebileceğini ifade etti. HÜKÜMETİN BÜTÇE SINAVI 2027 bütçesi parlamentodan geçebilecek mi? Fransa hükümeti, bütçe açığını 2026’da gayrisafi yurt içi hasılanın yüzde 5,4’ü seviyesinden 2027’de yüzde 5’e düşürmeyi hedefliyor. Tasarruf sağlamayı amaçlayan vergi düzenlemelerinin Ulusal Meclis’te 27 Ekim’de yeniden görüşülmesi planlanıyor. Ancak muhalefet milletvekilleri hükümetin planlarına karşı çıkıyor. Bütçenin parlamentodan geçip geçmeyeceği belirsizliğini korurken hükümetin, belirli koşullarda nihai oylama olmadan yasa çıkarılmasına olanak tanıyan Anayasa’nın 49.3’üncü maddesini kullanabileceği belirtiliyor. TAHVİL FAİZLERİ 2002’DEN BU YANA ZİRVEDE Fransa’nın borçlanma maliyetleri yükseliyor Fransa’nın gösterge niteliğindeki 10 yıllık devlet tahvillerinin getirisi perşembe günü 11 baz puan yükselerek 2002’den bu yana en yüksek seviyesine çıktı. Fransız ve Alman 10 yıllık devlet tahvilleri arasındaki getiri farkı da Kasım 2011’den bu yana en geniş seviyeye ulaştı. Natixis CIB’den Alain Durré, son dönemde Fransız devlet tahvillerindeki baskının ağırlıklı olarak portföylerdeki taktiksel değişimlerden kaynaklandığını, geleneksel uzun vadeli yatırımcıların ise henüz piyasaya dönmediğini söyledi. PROTESTOLAR BÜYÜMEYİ VURABİLİR Ekonomi için büyüme tahminleri düşük ING’nin Fransa ve İsviçre Başekonomisti Charlotte de Montpellier, protestoların devam etmesi ve güvenin daha da zayıflaması halinde ekonomik büyümenin mevcut tahminlerin altında kalabileceğini belirtti. ING, Fransa ekonomisinin 2026’da yüzde 0,3, 2027’de ise yüzde 0,6 büyümesini bekliyor. De Montpellier, şiddet olaylarının tüketicileri şehir merkezlerinden uzaklaştırabileceğini, turistlerin seyahatlerini ertelemesine ve şirketlerin yatırımlarını geciktirmesine neden olabileceğini ifade etti. Geçmiş protestolar da ekonomik faaliyet üzerinde etkili olmuştu. INSEE tahminine göre Sarı Yelekliler hareketi, 2018’in son çeyreğinde Fransa’nın büyümesini 0,1 puan düşürmüş olabilir. Fransa Merkez Bankası verilerine göre 2023 baharındaki emeklilik protestoları sırasında düzenlenen grevler de ilk çeyrek büyümesini yaklaşık 0,1 puan azalttı. HANGİ SEKTÖRLER DAHA FAZLA ETKİLENECEK? Perakende, turizm ve taşımacılık öne çıkıyor Fransa’nın CAC 40 endeksi son bir ayda yüzde 4,5 geriledi. ING, protestolardan doğrudan etkilenme riski en yüksek sektörler arasında perakende, konaklama ve turizm ile taşımacılık ve lojistiği gösterdi. Mağazalar ve alışveriş merkezleri ziyaretçi sayısındaki düşüş, kapanmalar ve satış kayıplarıyla karşılaşabilir. Oteller, kafeler, restoranlar ve seyahat hizmetleri de iptal edilen faaliyetlerin daha sonra telafi edilmesinin zor olması nedeniyle risk altında bulunuyor. Süpermarket zinciri Carrefour, protestoların yanı sıra yükselen enerji maliyetlerinin tüketici güvenini olumsuz etkilediğini belirterek kâr beklentisini düşürdü ve yatırım planlarını azalttı. Şirketin hisseleri çarşamba günü yüzde 14’ten fazla geriledi. ING’nin Fransa’daki ticaret odalarının tahminlerine dayandırdığı değerlendirmesine göre salı gününe kadar 2 binden fazla işletme protestolardan doğrudan etkilenmişti. BANKALAR VE LÜKS TÜKETİM DE RİSK ALTINDA Belirsizlik şirketlerin faaliyetlerine yayılabilir Carmignac Yatırım Komitesi üyesi Kevin Thozet’ye göre siyasi belirsizliğin uzaması bankaları da etkileyebilir. Öz sermaye maliyetlerinin yükselmesi, kredi büyümesinin yavaşlaması ve kredi sorunlarının ortaya çıkması finans sektörü açısından öne çıkan riskler arasında yer alıyor. Fransa’nın lüks tüketim sektörü satışlarının büyük bölümünü yurt dışında gerçekleştiriyor. LVMH’nin 2025 gelirlerinin yüzde 8’i Fransa’dan elde edildi. Ancak protestoların turizmi ve turistlerin vergisiz alışverişlerini azaltması şirketi etkileyebilir. Thozet, Fransa’daki LVMH gelirlerinin yaklaşık yüzde 20’sinin vergisiz alışverişlerden kaynaklandığını belirtti. Fransa’da 24 Ekim için yeni gösteriler, sendikaların desteklediği ülke çapındaki grev ve protestolar içinse 5 Kasım tarihi öne çıkıyor. Yatırımcılar, eylemlerin ne kadar süreceğini ve siyasi belirsizliğin bütçe planları ile ekonomik faaliyet üzerindeki etkisini izliyor.

articles.summary: Bill Gates, yapay zekanın önümüzdeki 20 yılda iş hayatını ve toplumu kökten değiştirebileceği uyarısında bulundu. Gates, teknolojik dönüşümün kazananlar ve kaybedenler yaratacağını belirterek hükümetlere daha güçlü denetim ve güvenlik önlemleri çağrısı yaptı.

articles.articleText: Bill Gates 'yapay' geleceği açıkladı: İnsanlığı 20 yıllık büyük bir sarsıntı bekliyor - Bill Gates, yapay zekanın önümüzdeki 20 yılda iş hayatını ve toplumu kökten değiştirebileceği uyarısında bulundu. Gates, teknolojik dönüşümün kazananlar ve kaybedenler yaratacağını belirterek hükümetlere daha güçlü denetim ve güvenlik önlemleri çağrısı yaptı. Microsoft'un kurucu ortağı Bill Gates, yapay zeka odaklı ekonomiye geçişin önümüzdeki 20 yılda ciddi ekonomik ve toplumsal çalkantılara yol açabileceğini söyledi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Perşembe günü yayımlanan Decoder podcast'ine konuşan Gates, yapay zekanın başarıyla yönetilmesi durumunda bile bu dönüşümün kazananlar ve kaybedenler yaratacağını belirtti. Gates, “Benim en büyük endişem, kazananların ve kaybedenlerin olacağı ve büyük bir sarsıntının yaşanacağı bu 20 yıllık geçiş dönemi” dedi. Gates'e göre toplum, teknolojinin yaratabileceği olası bolluk dönemine ulaşmadan önce bu çalkantılı geçiş sürecini aşmak zorunda kalabilir. Robotlar ameliyat yapacak, ev ve gıda üretiminde görev alacak Gates, yapay zeka ve insansı robot teknolojilerindeki ilerlemelerin makinelerin bugün insanlar tarafından yapılan fiziksel işlerin önemli bir bölümünü üstlenmesini sağlayabileceğini belirtti. Bu dönüşümün ev inşaatından gıda üretimine, hatta cerrahi operasyonlara kadar uzanabileceğini ifade eden Gates, teknolojinin mal ve hizmetlere erişimdeki kıtlıkları azaltma potansiyeline de dikkat çekti. Ancak Gates, önümüzdeki 20 yıllık sürenin kesin bir tahmin olmadığını vurguladı. Geçiş döneminin uzunluğunun teknolojik ilerlemenin hızına ve yapay zekanın gelişimini yavaşlatmaya yönelik kararlara bağlı olarak değişebileceğini söyledi. Her işi makinelere bırakmak istemeyebiliriz Gates, makinelerin daha fazla işi üstlenmesine rağmen toplumların bazı faaliyetleri bilinçli olarak insanlara ayırmayı tercih edebileceğini belirtti. Çocuk bakımı, yemek hazırlama, sanat ve spor bu alanlar arasında yer aldı. Gates ayrıca yapay zekanın sağlık hizmetleri ve tarımda önemli faydalar sağlayabileceğini ifade etti. Bununla birlikte hükümetlerin ve toplumların teknolojik dönüşümün hızına yeterince hazırlıklı olmadığı uyarısında bulundu. Gates'ten hükümetlere güvenlik ve denetim çağrısı Yapay zekanın oluşturabileceği risklerin yönetilmesi için hükümetlerin daha güçlü denetim mekanizmaları kurması gerektiğini söyleyen Gates, siber saldırılar ve biyolojik tehditlere karşı teknik güvenlik önlemlerinin geliştirilmesini istedi. Yapay zeka şirketlerinin bu risklerle tek başlarına mücadele edemeyeceğini belirten Gates, hükümetlerin ve toplumun da sorumluluk üstlenmesi gerektiğini vurguladı. Gates, “İnsanlar olarak bu süreci nasıl şekillendireceğimize ilişkin seçimler yapma imkanımız var” diyerek teknolojik dönüşümün sonuçlarının alınacak kararlara bağlı olduğuna işaret etti.

articles.title: Ukraine says Starlink connection 'now stable' after network limits
articles.summary: The slowed Starlink connections had affected the Ukraine's military and drone operations for a week.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Ukraine says Starlink connection 'now stable' after network limits
articles.summaryTr: The slowed Starlink connections had affected the Ukraine's military and drone operations for a week.
articles.articleText: Ukraine says Starlink connection 'now stable' after network limits - Published Ukraine now has a "stable connection" to Starlink, its defence minister has said, after its military suffered days of restricted connectivity on the satellite internet network. Kyiv relies on the Starlink and its military-grade counterpart Starshield for piloting drones and operations within Ukraine, but last week accused US President Donald Trump of telling owner Elon Musk to place limits on it. This meant drones would lose connection when travelling at 161km/h (100mph) or more, it said. Trump denied doing so before saying Musk had "put it back". Defence Minister Yevhenii Khmara said that speeds of more than 400km/h were now possible on the network, indicating that full capability had been restored. "This result is above all important for our front, for our soldiers, for the operation of drones, for logistics and for communications," he said in a statement on Saturday. Ukraine's military uses the network of 10,000 low Earth orbit satellites extensively for military operations, particularly in remote areas on the battlefield. Ukraine uses both the civilian service Starlink and the more secure Starshield, which Musk said was controlled by the US military when he suggested the Pentagon could be behind the recent issues. Russia is not authorised to use Starlink, so when Ukraine sends long-range missiles or drones deep into Russia to hit oil refineries, the network does not work. The debacle over Starlink began last week, and emerged during a broader diplomatic row between Trump and his Ukrainian counterpart Volodymyr Zelensky over Ukrainian strikes on Russian oil infrastructure. Faced with midterm elections next month, Trump has waived some sanctions on Russia and agreed a deal to import Russian diesel for the US market - a move criticised by Ukraine and its European allies. Trump said the strikes on Russian oil refineries, which Kyiv says are crucial to stemming the main revenue source for Moscow's war effort, have pushed global prices higher. While the attacks have had an impact on global fuel prices, rises seen this year have primarily been due to the Iran war. Zelensky said that, as well as seemingly limiting Starlink capability in Ukraine, the US had also threatened to withdraw intelligence sharing if the strikes did not stop, something Trump also denied. Meanwhile, fighting on the ground continues. Russia's ministry of defence wrote on Telegram on Saturday that their air defences shot down 616 Ukrainian fixed-wing drones, striking a number of regions across the country, including Russian-annexed Crimea. Sergey Aksyonov, the region's Moscow-backed governor, said restrictions on electricity and water had been put in place because of power cuts caused by the drone strike. Meanwhile, Ukrainian authorities said they struck a missile component manufacturer, a chemical plant and an aircraft at a military airfield inside Russia in the past 24 hours. They also said that Russia carried out 88 air strikes using 309 glide bombs and 10,270 kamikaze drones on Friday. Related topics - Published15 October

Zelensky said that, as well as seemingly limiting Starlink capability in Ukraine, the US had also threatened to withdraw intelligence sharing if the strikes did not stop, something Trump also denied. Meanwhile, fighting on the ground continues. Russia's ministry of defence wrote on Telegram on Saturday that their air defences shot down 616 Ukrainian fixed-wing drones, striking a number of regions across the country, including Russian-annexed Crimea. Sergey Aksyonov, the region's Moscow-backed governor, said restrictions on electricity and water had been put in place because of power cuts caused by the drone strike. Meanwhile, Ukrainian authorities said they struck a missile component manufacturer, a chemical plant and an aircraft at a military airfield inside Russia in the past 24 hours. They also said that Russia carried out 88 air strikes using 309 glide bombs and 10,270 kamikaze drones on Friday. Related topics - Published15 October

articles.title: U.S. Clarity Act failure gives Asia and Middle East a competitive edge, says Apex Group CEO
articles.summary: Apex Group CEO Peter Hughes warned that the failure of the U.S. Clarity Act will drive digital asset businesses toward faster-moving jurisdictions in Asia and the Middle East.

articles.titleTr: U.S. Clarity Act failure gives Asia and Middle East a competitive edge, says Apex Group CEO
articles.summaryTr: Apex Group CEO Peter Hughes warned that the failure of the U.S. Clarity Act will drive digital asset businesses toward faster-moving jurisdictions in Asia and the Middle East.
articles.articleText: U.S. Clarity Act failure gives Asia and Middle East a competitive edge, says Apex Group CEO Apex Group CEO Peter Hughes warned that the failure of the U.S. Clarity Act will drive digital asset businesses toward faster-moving jurisdictions in Asia and the Middle East. - The U.S. risks losing digital asset business to faster-moving jurisdictions in Asia, the Middle East and Bermuda after the Senate failed to advance the Clarity Act, Apex Group CEO Peter Hughes said. - Hughes said Europe’s crypto rules remain restrictive, while Saudi Arabia is emerging as a tokenization hub by opening its real estate market to digital assets and greater foreign investment. - Tokenized money market funds and regulated, yield-bearing stablecoins could accelerate institutional adoption by offering higher returns, collateral utility and broader access than traditional financial products, Hughes said. The U.S. risks losing digital asset business to Asia and the Middle East if it continues to delay crypto legislation or fails to implement a clear, certain regulatory framework for digital assets, said Peter Hughes, founder and CEO of Apex Group, a global financial firm. Hughes said, however, that Europe will not benefit from Washington’s setback despite having its own rules in place since July 1. “I think that the Clarity Act and the delay around that will lead to people finding other solutions elsewhere,” Hughes told CoinDesk in an interview. Hughes singled out Europe’s Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA), describing it as slow to evolve and restrictive. “But I do think there's opportunities in Asia, which are moving quickly; the Middle East; even places like Bermuda are moving quickly around having the right regimes to really produce the product for the future, and they'll step into this gap,” he said. The U.S. Senate last month failed to pass the Clarity Act, which would have established clearer federal rules for digital assets and divided oversight between the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) and the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC). The bill fell short of the 60 votes needed in September after disputes over ethics provisions, stablecoin rewards and other regulatory concerns. Regulatory uncertainty The delay leaves uncertainty over how those products will be regulated in the world’s largest economy for companies building blockchain-based financial products.t Hughes believes faster-moving jurisdictions could attract business that might otherwise have gone to the United States. The SEC and CFTC moved soon after proposing their own set of crypto rules, in an attempt to fill the void left by lawmakers’ failure to reach consensus. Apex Group, which services more than $3.5 trillion in assets, operates across 50 jurisdictions. Earlier this month, it announced a partnership with droppRWA and Tokeny to help turn real-world assets (RWAs) into regulated blockchain-based investment products, starting in Saudi Arabia. Faisal Monai, the CEO and founder of tokenization platform droppRWA said Saudi Arabia has already made regulatory changes allowing real estate tokenization and greater foreign participation in its property market. What remains, he said, is infrastructure connecting each digital token directly to the legal record of the underlying asset. “As long as we can maintain that, then the funds will be able to convey with confidence to their investors that the asset exists, what it’s worth and who owns it,” Monai said. Hughes also suggested that U.S. banking institutions have influenced the debate around the Clarity and GENIUS acts as they seek to protect their position in the financial system. Banks have raised concerns about stablecoin rewards competing with traditional deposits, although the Senate bill faced significant objections over political ethics and regulatory safeguards. “The key thing is the scale, and that scale isn't really in these areas,” he said. Beyond Clarity Beyond the regulatory debate, Hughes sees tokenized money market funds as one of the biggest drivers of institutional adoption. These funds invest in traditional short-term debt but issue blockchain-based tokens representing investors’ holdings. Hughes argued that they could compete with bank savings accounts by passing more of the investment returns directly to customers. Hughes cited a comparison of 5% returns from a tokenized money market fund against 3% from a bank savings account. He said the difference in returns could become an important reason for investors to choose tokenized money market funds over traditional bank savings accounts as adoption grows. Another advantage, according to Hughes, is that tokenized funds can be used as collateral, allowing institutions to borrow against their holdings rather than leaving the money tied up in traditional investment accounts. He said major banks are already examining that use. Hughes expects regulated, yield-bearing stablecoins to become an important tool for corporate treasuries, provided issuers meet requirements including reserve transparency. “Whether that happens in one, three, or five years, it's hard to judge,” the Bermuda-based financial firm’s CEO added. Hughes said he expects tokenization to reach a wider range of investors, including retirement accounts and retail customers, as regulators become more comfortable with the technology. Smaller investment amounts, faster product creation and broader distribution could help bring traditional financial products to people who previously had limited access, he said. Monai sees a similar opportunity in Saudi Arabia, predicting that tokenization could eventually become a mainstream way for foreign investors to put capital into the country without having to establish local presence. “I foresee that tokenization will be the mainstream for capital moving into Saudi Arabia,” Monai said. Diversified RWA stablecoins sustain 5-7% yield from real credit as crypto funding compresses to ~4%. GENIUS pushes yield off-chain; TAM grows to $4B in 3 years. articles.title: Rising demand from families needing Christmas help
articles.summary: Charlotte Riley says more families are reaching out for help for a variety of reasons.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Rising demand from families needing Christmas help
articles.summaryTr: Charlotte Riley says more families are reaching out for help for a variety of reasons.
articles.articleText: Rising demand from families needing Christmas help - Published The number of families asking for help to afford Christmas presents is rising, according to the organiser of a charitable cause. For the past two years Charlotte Riley has collected and distributed donated gifts voluntarily as part of Christmas Kindness Appeal Jersey which she organises through Facebook. The gifts are given to families for children aged up to 18. Riley said: "What we are seeing is that each year we're getting more and more numbers coming through." She said the donated gifts helped to "take the pressure off" families in need of support. Riley said when she first started the appeal in 2024 she "didn't expect the response from the community". She said: "I knew there were people in need. "I didn't quite know how many people that would be." She said the reasons people might reach out to the appeal included unemployment, ill health and the general high cost of living. Along with more demand, Riley said there were also increasing numbers of people offering to help. "It wouldn't be done without those other people helping," she said. "We have people doing deliveries, we have people doing pickups... we have people that have accessed this and got gifts in previous years that are now saying 'I want to give back' so they will go and do collections for us as well." Riley said there was a three-week window for donations which can include clothes, food and essentials as well as gifts. Donations can be made before 14 November. "People are very complimentary and very thankful," Riley said. She said she wanted parents to feel part of the process so they were also given wrapping paper and labels. "It's the small simple things as well that make that big difference," she said. Follow BBC Jersey on X, external, Facebook, external and Instagram, external. articles.titleTr: Charity expects demand for Christmas present campaign
articles.summaryTr: The campaign, run by Little Stars, is running from today until 4 December.
articles.articleText: Charity expects demand for Christmas present campaign - Published A Shropshire charity has said it expects demand to be high this year for its campaign which provides Christmas presents to struggling families. Little Stars, which gives away free essentials to families in need, has launched Santa's Little Stars, which runs from Saturday 24 October to Friday 4 December. The public is asked to donate new, unwrapped toys and gifts to donation points in Shrewsbury's Darwin shopping centre. Donations are wrapped and given to children from birth to age 17, as well as pregnant women who are referred to the charity. Little Stars said 2025 was its biggest campaign year to date, and it expected demand to continue to be high due to many families continuing to face financial pressures. The charity launched Santa's Little Stars in 2020 and has given out more than 8,000 presents in that time, supporting more than 2,100 children. It added that donations could be taken to collection points outside the Collective, The Entertainer, Home Bargains and Clarks Shoes. articles.summary: She was a close family member of the first victim, a man who had travelled from the Democratic Republic of Congo.

articles.titleTr: Woman, 65, becomes second patient to die of Ebola in Kenya
articles.summaryTr: She was a close family member of the first victim, a man who had travelled from the Democratic Republic of Congo.
articles.articleText: Woman, 65, becomes second patient to die of Ebola in Kenya - Published Kenya has recorded its second death from Ebola as it handles its first ever outbreak of the disease. A woman, aged 65, who was a close family member of the first victim, a man who had travelled from the Democratic Republic of Congo, died after being placed in quarantine, the health ministry said. Seven other Ebola patients were receiving treatment at two isolation facilities, it added. All the cases were within "one cluster, with no evidence of community spread", the ministry said. More than 4,000 people have died in Africa since Ebola was confirmed in DR Congo in May, making it the second most deadly outbreak of the disease. Kenya's latest victim had been under quarantine when she developed symptoms on 13 October, the health ministry said. The first death, on 5 October, was that of a man who fell ill in September and was treated in several hospitals in DR Congo before arriving in the Kenyan capital, Nairobi, where he died a few days later. Those still being treated are three other relatives of the first victim, three health workers and a hospital cleaner. The US has warned its citizens against travelling to Kenya, while neighbouring countries such as Uganda, Ethiopia and Somalia are also on alert. Ebola is a rare but deadly disease, external caused by a virus. As the disease progresses, vomiting and diarrhoea develop and it can lead to organ failure. Some, but not all, patients develop internal and external bleeding. The disease spreads from one person to another by contact with infected bodily fluids such as blood or vomit. The Bundibugyo species of Ebola is relatively rare, with no approved vaccine or treatment - though trials are under way. With more than 9,500 cases in DR Congo, Kenya faces a steady risk of new cases arriving across borders, according to the International Rescue Committee, which has been working alongside both governments to contain the spread. Kenya has introduced enhanced screening for travellers arriving from DR Congo and nine other countries it considers to be at high risk: Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda, Burundi, Angola, Zambia, Ethiopia, South Sudan and the Central African Republic. Travellers arriving from those countries are required to complete a digital surveillance form before boarding their flights and present a QR code to port health officials on arrival. Kenya also ordered enhanced public health screening of aircraft arriving from those countries, as authorities seek to prevent further imported cases. Within the country, the government has been sharing public messages to create awareness about Ebola, including encouraging people to promptly report any suspected cases and seek care at a hospital. - Is Ebola under control in Kenya after nine cases confirmed? - Published3 days ago - Woman with Ebola in Nigeria confirmed as wife of Swiss diplomat - Published1 day ago Nigeria's health minister said its sole confirmed case of Ebola appeared to be genetically related to a strain identified earlier in Kenya. Prof Ali Pate said there was no evidence so far that the Kenyan patient had travelled to Nigeria, but that further testing was under way. Health officials have been investigating whether Nigeria's first case crossed paths with Kenya's first patient. Both are believed to have travelled through Uganda's Entebbe airport earlier this month. Uganda's health ministry announced on Friday that people who had travelled to DR Congo would no longer be able to transit via Uganda as part of its prevention measures. articles.title: Franklin Templeton adds $150 million in fund shares to XRP Ledger, all in one wallet
articles.summary: Two subscriptions on Thursday nearly quadrupled the fund’s tokens on the network. The receiving wallet shares its authorized signers with the issuer.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Franklin Templeton adds $150 million in fund shares to XRP Ledger, all in one wallet
articles.summaryTr: Two subscriptions on Thursday nearly quadrupled the fund’s tokens on the network. The receiving wallet shares its authorized signers with the issuer.
articles.articleText: Franklin Templeton adds $150 million in fund shares to XRP Ledger, all in one wallet Two subscriptions on Thursday nearly quadrupled the fund’s tokens on the network. The receiving wallet shares its authorized signers with the issuer. - Franklin Templeton added about $150 million in shares of its tokenized money market fund to the XRP Ledger, bringing the network’s total to nearly 193 million shares worth about $200 million. - All sgBENJI shares on the XRP Ledger remain in a single wallet that shares transaction signers with Franklin’s issuing account, though it is unclear whether the wallet represents one investor or multiple clients. - The fund invests in short-term dollar debt and money-market instruments, and its XRP Ledger holdings can be approved, frozen or recovered by Franklin. Franklin Templeton added $150 million worth of shares in its tokenized money market fund to the XRP Ledger earlier Friday, with every new share went to one wallet which now holds the fund’s entire token balance on the network. That wallet and Franklin’s issuing account authorize the identical eight signing addresses. Any two can jointly approve a transaction, according to CoinDesk’s review of ledger records. The wallet holds nearly 193 million sgBENJI shares, up from about 48 million before Thursday. At the $1.039 share price recorded in the transactions, that is worth about $200 million. RWA.xyz ranks Franklin second in its XRP Ledger table of tokenized asset platforms, behind Ripple’s RLUSD stablecoin at about $930 million and ahead of Ondo at $185 million. Each token represents a share of the Singapore-domiciled Franklin OnChain U.S. Dollar Short-Term Money Market Fund. It invests in short-term dollar debt and money-market instruments, including government paper, commercial paper and bank deposits. Returns accumulate in the share price. On Wednesday, Franklin’s issuing account wrote two subscription receipts onto the ledger. Each recorded a $75 million cash subscription and carried its own reference code. Two batches of just over 72,184,793 shares followed at 02:58 and 04:13 UTC Thursday, each carrying a matching receipt code and a $1.039 share price. The receipts leave the investors, funding source and any connection to existing holdings on Stellar, the other blockchain the fund uses, undisclosed. RWA.xyz lists Franklin’s XRP Ledger position at about $193 million, matching the share count at a dollar each. Thursday’s recorded share price puts its value nearly $8 million higher. Why one wallet Brokers and custodians routinely hold shares for many clients in one account, tracking individual ownership separately. Franklin’s fund documents describe a register combining blockchain entries with records held outside the network, including information “which links the wallet addresses of the entries on the distributed ledger to their real-world identities.” Whether this particular wallet represents one investor or several remains unclear. CoinDesk asked Franklin whether it is an omnibus account, how many investors funded the subscriptions and whether they or their custodians will receive tokens in separate addresses. The firm had not responded as of Asia morning hours on Saturday. Franklin and DBS announced the fund’s Singapore-authorized structure in November 2025 with a $20 minimum investment. Initially available to wealth and accredited clients, retail access was expected in early 2026. Their September 2025 agreement with Ripple outlined plans for eligible DBS Digital Exchange clients to switch between sgBENJI and RLUSD. DBS also said it would explore lending against the fund tokens. Holding sgBENJI directly on XRPL requires Franklin’s approval. Its settings also allow the issuer to freeze balances and recover tokens. Thursday’s transactions nearly quadrupled the number of sgBENJI shares on the XRP Ledger. The number of wallets holding any of them stayed at one. Two batches of just over 72,184,793 shares followed at 02:58 and 04:13 UTC Thursday, each carrying a matching receipt code and a $1.039 share price. The receipts leave the investors, funding source and any connection to existing holdings on Stellar, the other blockchain the fund uses, undisclosed. RWA.xyz lists Franklin’s XRP Ledger position at about $193 million, matching the share count at a dollar each. Thursday’s recorded share price puts its value nearly $8 million higher. Why one wallet Brokers and custodians routinely hold shares for many clients in one account, tracking individual ownership separately. Franklin’s fund documents describe a register combining blockchain entries with records held outside the network, including information “which links the wallet addresses of the entries on the distributed ledger to their real-world identities.” Whether this particular wallet represents one investor or several remains unclear. CoinDesk asked Franklin whether it is an omnibus account, how many investors funded the subscriptions and whether they or their custodians will receive tokens in separate addresses. The firm had not responded as of Asia morning hours on Saturday. Franklin and DBS announced the fund’s Singapore-authorized structure in November 2025 with a $20 minimum investment. Initially available to wealth and accredited clients, retail access was expected in early 2026. Their September 2025 agreement with Ripple outlined plans for eligible DBS Digital Exchange clients to switch between sgBENJI and RLUSD. DBS also said it would explore lending against the fund tokens. Holding sgBENJI directly on XRPL requires Franklin’s approval. Its settings also allow the issuer to freeze balances and recover tokens. Thursday’s transactions nearly quadrupled the number of sgBENJI shares on the XRP Ledger. The number of wallets holding any of them stayed at one. articles.title: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Louisiana Man and His Companies to Pay Over $9 Million in Forex Fraud
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Louisiana Man and His Companies to Pay Over $9 Million in Forex Fraud
articles.articleText: Release Number 9313-26 CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Louisiana Man and His Companies to Pay Over $9 Million in Forex Fraud October 21, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Louisiana entered a default judgment against defendants Michael B. DePetrillo, Meteor LLC, and NOLA FX Capital Management LLC for their participation in a fraudulent retail forex scheme. In entering the default judgment, the court found the defendants fraudulently solicited and misappropriated more than $3 million from participants. The court found the defendants falsely represented that participant funds would be used to trade retail forex, made material misrepresentations and omissions regarding the profitability of forex trading with them, and issued false account statements to conceal their misconduct. The court further found the defendants misappropriated participant funds by making payments to existing participants in a manner akin to a Ponzi scheme, paying DePetrillo’s personal expenses, and trading in DePetrillo’s personal account. The court ordered the defendants to pay a $9,211,492 civil monetary penalty. The order also permanently enjoins the defendants from further violations of the Commodity Exchange Act and Commission regulations, as charged, and imposes permanent trading and registration bans. The default judgment resolves all claims in the CFTC’s 2024 complaint. [See CFTC Press Release No. 9003-24] On Feb. 18, 2025, in a related criminal case, DePetrillo pleaded guilty to violating the Commodity Exchange Act in connection with the same conduct in the CFTC’s complaint. On July 23, 2025, the court sentenced him to nine years in prison and ordered him to pay $6,748,412 in restitution. The CFTC appreciates the assistance of the U.S. Attorney’s Office for the Eastern District of Louisiana and the FBI New Orleans Division. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Secures Federal Court Orders Requiring Former Long Island Resident and His Firm to Pay Over $288 Million for Operating a Commodity Pool Ponzi Scheme
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Secures Federal Court Orders Requiring Former Long Island Resident and His Firm to Pay Over $288 Million for Operating a Commodity Pool Ponzi Scheme
articles.articleText: Release Number 9311-26 CFTC Secures Federal Court Orders Requiring Former Long Island Resident and His Firm to Pay Over $288 Million for Operating a Commodity Pool Ponzi Scheme October 19, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York entered orders granting the CFTC’s motions for summary judgment, injunctive relief, and a civil monetary penalty against Eddy Alexandre of Valley Stream, New York, and his company, EminiFX Inc., which operated in Valley Stream and Manhattan, New York. The orders require the defendants to pay $228,576,962 in restitution to the defrauded investors, to disgorge $15,049,500 in unlawful gains of (offset by any amounts paid in restitution), and to pay a $45,148,500 penalty. The orders stem from the CFTC’s May 12, 2022, complaint in this matter. [See CFTC Press Release No. 8527-22.] As described in the court’s summary judgment order, the defendants held themselves out as an investment club providing investors with an affordable solution that offered easy access to cryptocurrency and Forex trading using the latest technology available. Over the course of EminiFX’s eight months in operation, tens of thousands of investors sent contributions exceeding $262 million. According to the order, the defendants reported “astonishing” returns on investment of 5% to 9.99% per week. In reality, EminiFX experienced net losses exceeding $49 million. At least $15 million of those losses resulted from Alexandre’s misappropriation of investor funds for his own use. As noted by the court, “Simply put, EminiFX was a Ponzi scheme, and investors’ decisions to give their money to [d]efendants was predicated entirely on fraudulent misrepresentations.” During the CFTC’s lawsuit, the court-appointed receiver recovered millions of dollars in investor funds and other assets held by the defendants and is distributing those funds to the defrauded investors. As of July 2026, over $98 million has been returned to more than 28,000 investors. The CFTC cautions, however, that orders requiring repayment of funds to victims may not always result in the recovery of lost money because the wrongdoers may not have sufficient funds or assets. Alexandre is serving a nine-year prison sentence based on a parallel action for related conduct brought by the U.S. Attorney’s Office for the Southern District of New York. -CFTC-

articles.titleTr: CFTC Seeks Public Comment on Notice of Proposed Rulemaking Concerning the Inclusion of Certain Event Contracts in the Definition of Swap
articles.articleText: Release Number 9310-26 CFTC Seeks Public Comment on Notice of Proposed Rulemaking Concerning the Inclusion of Certain Event Contracts in the Definition of Swap October 09, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today published a Notice of Proposed Rulemaking that proposes providing additional market clarity by expressly further defining the term “swap” to include event contracts, including those based on sports, politics, cultural, and weather-related events. The proposal notes these contracts are financial instruments that are commonly known to the trade as swaps and proposes to resolve any ambiguity regarding these contracts. “Americans use event contracts to hedge risks, speculate, and provide the public with information about the outcome of future events,” said Chairman Michael S. Selig. “These products are commodity derivatives squarely within the CFTC’s regulatory remit under the Commodity Exchange Act and are within the agency’s exclusive jurisdiction.” Comments to the NPRM must be submitted in writing via Regulations.gov and received within 30 days of the NPRM’s publication in the Federal Register. -CFTC-

articles.articleText: Release Number 9309-26 CFTC Issues Interim Final Rule Excluding Certain Activity from the Definition of Swap October 09, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today published an Interim Final Rule that codifies the CFTC’s longstanding position that casino-style gambling products, including wagers placed on sportsbooks and casino games, are excluded from the “swap” definition. “Casino-style gambling products are not derivatives,” said Chairman Michael S. Selig. “Just as the CFTC has done with respect to other products historically regulated by the states, the Commission today provides clarity regarding the limits of its regulatory remit by codifying the exclusion of casino-style gambling products from the ‘swap’ definition.” The IFR will be effective immediately upon publication in the Federal Register and written comments must be received via Regulations.gov within 30 days of the IFR’s publication in the Federal Register. -CFTC-

news.title: Almost 1,000 arrested as clashes follow another day of mass protests across France
news.summary: Officials have so far managed to avoid a repeat of last weekend's rioting and looting as hundreds of thousands took part in demonstrations.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Almost 1,000 arrested as clashes follow another day of mass protests across France
news.summaryTr: Officials have so far managed to avoid a repeat of last weekend's rioting and looting as hundreds of thousands took part in demonstrations.
news.articleText: Almost 1,000 arrested as clashes follow another day of mass protests across France - Published Nearly 1,000 arrests were made as hundreds of thousands of people took part in another day of protests across France which were followed by some clashes late on Saturday, officials have said. After a day of largely peaceful demonstrations, police fired tear gas and water cannon to disperse protesters in a number of cities including Paris, while barricades were set alight in Marseille and people ripped boards from a shop in Bordeaux. But officials have so far managed to avoid rioting and looting on the scale seen last weekend, which resulted in some of the worst scenes of disorder in France's modern history. The interior ministry said an estimated 410,000 people protested on Saturday, while the unions put the number at about 800,000. Some 70,000 police officers were deployed and restrictions imposed in several cities to prevent the latest protests over the cost of living and poor school conditions from descending into the kind of chaos which saw officers outnumbered, hundreds of businesses looted and buildings torched. President Emmanuel Macron had decreed earlier this week that only demonstrations organised by a recognised trade unions would be permitted. Hundreds of people have been jailed for vandalism, arson and looting after fast-track court hearings in recent days. Clashes between protesters and riot police in Paris erupted at the end of a peaceful march from the city's Porte d'Italie towards Porte de Vincennes on Saturday, where the police operation included an elite unit that usually deals with organised crime and counter-terrorism. Some protesters were seen erecting makeshift barricades and pelting officers with projectiles, while police baton-charged groups of masked youths who were smashing the windows of a car dealership. French Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez said that "several thousand radical activists gathered at the rear of the march, including around 500 individuals identified as rioters", the AFP news agency reported. In the southern port of Marseille, rubbish bins were set ablaze and metal sheets used to block streets. A law enforcement vehicle was seen driving through a burning barricade in France's second-largest city. Meanwhile, some protesters in dark clothing and face coverings were seen taking boards off a building to build a street barricade in the southern city of Bordeaux. In Lyon, police used tear gas grenades to disperse a crowd which had reportedly gathered in an area deemed off-limits by the local prefecture. "There were around 150 of us, mostly secondary school and university students. Then the tear gas came almost immediately. You could barely see anything in the street," said one protester in France's third-largest city. Nuñez said late in the day that nearly 1,000 people had been arrested, a number he said would increase. The minister also said two people had been "seriously injured": one in the south-western city of Toulouse, and another one in Clermont-Ferrand, central France. Earlier, a peaceful protester in Paris who gave her name as Zelie told the BBC people had taken to the streets because they were "really frustrated" and had been "suffering a lot" since Macron came to office. "They keep us quiet. They take our money, they tax us a lot and we can't say anything. Today we are in the streets because it's been too long, it's been too much," the 26-year-old said. Two masked teenage protesters, who did not want to give their names, also said their generation was in despair and felt abandoned by the government. "I think looting is really not good," one of the demonstrators said of last Saturday's disorder. "But it's because of poverty and the violence of the police." He added that the protests would end "when we have a response to our demands. We really want a change in France". Meanwhile, some 13,000 people joined a rally against the hard-right National Rally party in the north-central city of Orléans which proceeded peacefully. Mass protests triggered by similar issues as in France also rocked several other European cities on Saturday. In Albania's capital Tirana, riot police fired tear gas to disperse thousands of anti-government demonstrators, while clashes were also reported in Belgium's capital Brussels. In Milan, northern Italy, a major security operation including hundreds of soldiers alongside police prevented protesters gathering in the city. Many had feared a repeat of violent scenes last week when some started fires, smashed windows and looted shops. Around 550,000 people took part in last weekend's demonstrations against rising fuel prices and the cost of living, with frustrations escalating after weeks of student protests. The chaos which followed resulted in more than 2,500 arrests. Marches were initially largely peaceful but became marred by scenes of violence, looting and destruction, with more than 2,000 shops and other businesses across France said to have been directly impacted. The damage was estimated "at hundreds of millions euros", France's Chambers of Commerce and Industry (CCI) said. One demonstrator's hand was blown off by a police crowd-control grenade, according to the AFP news agency, while about 1,000 police officers were injured. The French authorities later said they were forced to impose overnight curfews in Paris and other cities. The continuing protests come ahead of France's presidential elections in six months' time, and leading contenders have levelled the blame at Macron and his ministers.
